description: Spine is a compact list of rows (status, kind, title, description) in design; code draws it as a flow graph of node cards on a dotted canvas, so later steps fall below the visible area (Fix findings, Publish preview, Ship it? need scrolling)
note: [detail] Classic TracksPane says it implements a newer "Tracks · Flow View" design; the .fdn board predates it

description: Attached panel (bees on this track with harness/model, status, age, current step, skipped-step note) is missing
note: [right-col] no Classic surface shows per-bee attachment cards; header shows only one bee in the live view

description: Exceptions section under the spine is missing in the proposal view
Help note "Steps are the agent's own to mark..." under the spine is missing
Pane title bar ("Tracks" 15px semibold + "7 defined · 5 attached · 3 queued" + more menu, full width) is replaced by a rail-only header: "TRACKS" 10px spaced caps label, bare count "7" and a + button
Filter tabs above the track list (All 7 / Attached 5 / Idle 2) are missing
Track list column is 317px wide in design, 232px in code

Track rows show version, last-activity time and live status counts (2 running · 1 review · 1 exception / no attachments) in design; code shows a static step summary ("7 steps · action ×3 · orch…") and no version or time
note: [row-meta] code rail is an authoring list; design rail is a live overview

description: Track row title is 13px (semibold when selected, medium otherwise) in design, 12.5px medium for every row in code; rows are 45px tall in design, 48px in code
Selected track row background is warm grey #EEEDE9 in design, light blue #DCE8F8 in code
note: [row-selected-bg] code uses the app-wide railSelection token

description: Idle tracks (dep-bump, nectar-preview) are dimmed in design (muted name #8A877F, faint glyph); code shows them like every other row
Track glyph is a small list/spine icon in design, a vertical chain of rings in code
Detail header shows track glyph, version badge "v3" and the description in design; code shows only the name plus a status line ("● proposal · 3 changes" in violet)
Header actions "Attach a bee (a)", "Edit spine (e)" and the more menu are missing; code offers a greyed "Attach to agent" instead
Code adds a Flow / Code view toggle to the header
Detail header is 45px tall with a 14.5px title in design, 40px with a 14px title in code
Detail area is white in design; in code it has no surface of its own and shows the warm app background #F5F4F1 with a dot grid
note: [main-bg] dot grid is part of the flow canvas design

description: Pane is a white card with 8px corner radius and drop shadow in design; code pane has square corners and no shadow
note: [pane-card] likely board presentation; in the app the pane chrome comes from the shell

description: Code adds a 36px AI sidecar rail on the right edge (hex icon + ⌘⌃B) with a violet proposal dot

Footer shows key hints "a attach · q queue behind · e edit spine · x exceptions" and "defined 4d ago · 3 versions · promoted on edit" in design; code shows "a proposed diff from the sidecar — nothing is real until you accept"
DENIED marker is an outlined pill on the Fix findings row in brick red #B0512E; code puts "DENIED ↺" on the flow connector in orange #BD6B3C

Step rows show a kind icon and kind label (ACTION / ORCHESTRATE / BRANCH / REVIEW / DEPLOY / ASK) in design; code cards show a generic icon and only some kinds as right-hand meta ("orchestrate", "gate", "blocking")
Step descriptions and LANE A / LANE B tags are missing on the cards
Branch step "Parallel — both lanes must land before the gate" is a titled row in design; code shows only an untitled frame around the two lanes
UI text is authored in the system font stack (-apple-system / Helvetica Neue, SF Mono) in design and in Hanken Grotesk / IBM Plex Mono in code
note: [font-family] authored stacks differ, independent of the Linux substitution

description: Design text renders in Linux substitutes (Liberation/DejaVu) for the Mac system fonts; 500/600 weights snap to 400/700. Not a product defect

Proposed edit is a card in the right column listing three change rows (+ Publish preview, ~ Verdict gate, − Manual smoke test) in design; code renders the proposal inline on the flow as violet dashed ghost cards and a removed card
note: [proposal-placement] TracksProposalOverlay: "violet diff — ghost added cards ... dimmed removals"

description: Accept / discard controls are visible in the proposal card in design; in code the action bar sits at the end of the flow (y≈1030) far below the visible area, so the user must scroll to accept

Proposal buttons: design is bordered "discard" then filled "accept ⌘↵" (accept on the right); code is filled "Accept ⌘↵", bordered "Refine", text-only "Discard ⌘⌫" (accept on the left), labels capitalised
Code adds a "Refine" action for the proposal
Proposal author/age ("sidecar-1 · 2m"), "PROPOSED EDIT" label and the "v3 → v4 · one pending at a time" note are missing

Proposal rationale reads "The suite passes but nothing publishes a preview for the human — add the deploy the review desk expects." in design; code shows a different summary ("Publish preview after the gate; add Fix findings on denial; replace Ma…") with a violet dot, below the visible area
note: [proposal-rationale] may be fixture wording rather than product copy

description: Code exposes internal node ids to the user ("n4d · proposed", "n5old · removed", "+n4d · +n5 · −n5old"); design never shows ids
While a proposal is pending, design keeps the live spine (done/current/upcoming markers), attached bees and queue; code switches to the editing view with no step status, attachments or queue
note: [proposal-no-status] code renders proposals in the editing register

description: Change rows are marked + / ~ / − in green / grey / red in design; code marks additions with dashed violet cards and removals with a "removed" label, and the "~ changed" Verdict gate has no marker
